stories.summary: The Philippines is hosting the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit and Related Summits in Manila from November 15 to 17, 2026, bringing together leaders from Southeast Asia and major Indo-Pacific powers to discuss regional security, economic cooperation and geopolitical challenges.

stories.title: Zuckerberg Faces New $900 Million Nightmare: Why Italy Is Taking On Meta | Explained
stories.summary: The Italian Data Protection Authority has imposed an $887 million penalty on Meta for accessing photographs, videos and related metadata stored on Android users’ phones without explicit consent. Around 20 million Italian Android users are estimated to have been affected. At the centre is Facebook’s “Gallery Suggestions” feature, which suggests phone photos and videos for posts.

stories.title: Gratuity formula explained: Who is eligible? We calculate how much you earn for 5, 10, and 15 years of service
stories.summary: With the 8th Central Pay Commission (CPC) in its consultation stage, a number of prominent unions have made a case for increase in gratuity limits besides other pension and salary reforms with view to improve livelihood of central government employees and pensioners. Notably, the National Council–Joint Consultative Machinery (NC-JCM) and the All India Defence Employees Federation ( AIDEF ) have proposed higher gratuity ceiling and revised retirement benefits among other demands.

stories.title: How did Jaden Agassi step out of his famous parents' shadow? Meet Andre Agassi and Steffi Graf's son chas
stories.summary: Jaden Agassi grew up with one of the most famous surnames in tennis, but he has chosen a very different sport to build his career. The 25-year-old son of Andre Agassi and Steffi Graf has developed into a baseball pitcher, played college baseball at the University of Southern California (USC) and represented Germany in the 2025 World Baseball Classic qualifiers.

stories.title: Can someone else’s missed EMI damage your borrowing prospects? What happens to credit score after becoming a guarantor?
stories.summary: When you agree to become a loan guarantor, it may seem like a straightforward and simple favour to a family member or a friend. Still, what you should not overlook is the fact that it can have serious financial consequences if the borrower fails to meet their repayment obligations and clear out the loan on time.

stories.title: Can poor air quality raise your risk of pneumonia? Experts explain what keeps you protected and what doesn't
stories.summary: Exposure to polluted air, smoke and harmful particles can weaken the lungs' natural defence mechanisms, increasing vulnerability to respiratory infections such as pneumonia. Doctors highlight that children, older adults and people with existing health conditions need extra protection. Tavishi Dogra is a Deputy Chief Content Producer, Health & Wellness, at Hindustan Times.

stories.title: Square brackets and sleepless nights: What really happens inside a UN climate summit | HT Explainers
stories.summary: Every year, nearly 200 countries gather at the Conference of the Parties (COP), the annual meeting of the 1992 United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), to negotiate global action on limiting global warming. Discussions include mitigation (cutting emissions), adaptation, climate finance, loss and damage (support for countries already harmed by climate change), and carbon markets.

stories.title: What is forest bathing? How the Japanese practice encourages you to reconnect with nature
stories.summary: When was the last time you walked among trees without checking your phone, rushing to reach a destination or thinking about your next task? The Japanese practice of forest bathing invites you to slow down and experience nature with your full attention. Known as shinrin-yoku, it offers a simple way to step away from daily distractions and reconnect with the world around you.

stories.title: Is the universe older than we think? New model suggests 26.7 billion years
stories.summary: 8 billion years. It also proposes that some phenomena attributed to dark matter and dark energy could instead be explained by changes in fundamental physical constants. The model was developed by Rajendra Gupta, an adjunct professor in the university’s Department of Physics. Along with postdoctoral researcher Nikolaos Samaras, he has been testing it against several major cosmological observations.

stories.title: How to catch a spaceship: The SpaceX Starship recovery in detail | HT Explainers
stories.summary: SpaceX on Saturday caught its Starship spacecraft with the giant mechanical arms of its launch tower in Texas as it came back from orbit, the first time a spaceship has been brought home this way and a step towards flying the same vehicle again and again. Catching the ship is much harder than catching the giant booster, something SpaceX has done three times before.

stories.title: Looking for something fun to do? Explore these interesting events in Mumbai
stories.summary: Mark the 130th birth anniversary of Dr S lim Ali (right), fondly remembered as the Birdman of India, with a special showcase celebrating his life, work and contribution to ornithology.

stories.title: Childrens Day 2026: Events And Activities To Check Out In Mumbai
stories.summary: Children's Day is just around the corner, and Mumbai has plenty of ways for little ones and their families to celebrate. From an international clown show and creative workshops to a kids' carnival and a fun marathon, there is something for children with different interests.

stories.title: Mumbai This Weekend: Coffee Fest, Kids Carnival—Check Out Exciting Events To Attend This Childrens Day
stories.summary: Looking for exciting plans in Mumbai this weekend? From spectacular circus performances and coffee celebrations to fun-filled carnivals and special Children's Day activities, the city has plenty to offer from November 13 to 15.

stories.title: Explore Jitish Kallat's new art exhibition in Mumbai at the Dr Bhau Daji Lad Museum in Byculla
stories.summary: For years, there has been a general consensus on the distinct nature of art and sciences. Yet, In Jitish Kallat’s ambitious new exhibition at the Dr Bhau Daji Lad Museum, they find commonality.

stories.title: From Lonavala to Asangaon: Unwind with these three unique trips around Mumbai this weekend
stories.summary: Round up your gang and hit the road to Lonavala in a camping van, with scenic drives and outdoor fun along the way, apart from these other weekend getaways

stories.title: New festival will celebrate the beauty of 8mm films, in Mumbai this December
stories.summary: The recent trend of recreating the 1980s retro nostalgia using AI (Artificial Intelligence) pointed to something far deeper. It reflected a need to return to a time that was not curated for an audience. It is such films and images that are slowly making their way to the Film Heritage Foundation’s labs in Mumbai.

stories.title: The Vvaan 2 announced on Chhath Puja, Ektaa Kapoor to take Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia's folklore fantasy forward with a new universe
stories.summary: The story of The Vvaan is not over yet. Ektaa Kapoor has announced its sequel, The Vvaan 2, on the occasion of Chhath Puja. Following the first film's theatrical run, the makers are now ready to return to its mysterious world and take the story further. Directed by Deepak Kumar Mishra, the first instalment featured Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia.

stories.title: Mumbai: Siddhivinayak Temple Introduces Four New Special Pujas, Fees Go Upto ₹50,000
stories.summary: Mumbai, November 16, 2026: The Shree Siddhivinayak Ganapati Temple Trust has introduced four new special pujas for devotees, expanding the range of religious services offered at the temple. The newly introduced rituals include Sahasranama Mahaprasad Puja, Sahasranama Ashirvachan Mahapuja, Shringarika Puja and Atharvashirsha Havan. Devotees wishing to perform these pujas or seeking further information can contact the puja booking counter at the temple.

stories.title: ‘ISKCON’, ‘Tantric’, ‘Gorak Nath’: 287 ‘other’ religions briefly listed on Census portal
stories.summary: Going by the government's initial classification of “other” religions in the self-enumeration portal for the Population Enumeration phase of Census 2027 , ‘ISKCON’, ‘Ramakrishna Paramahans’, ‘Sanatan’, ‘Shri Ram’, ‘Shri Krishna’, ‘Balmiki’, ‘Ramdev’, ‘Bishnoi’, ‘Sarna’, ‘Tantric’, ‘Yogi’, ‘Shia’, ‘Sunni’, ‘Methodist’, and ‘Pentecostal’, are among the religions practised in the country.

stories.title: Travancore Devaswom Board seeks Andhra Pradesh’s support for smooth Sabarimala pilgrimage
stories.summary: The Travancore Devaswom Board has made extensive arrangements for the annual Sabarimala pilgrimage season, which will continue for two months, its chairman K. Jayakumar has said. In a letter to Andhra Pradesh Chief Secretary G. Sai Prasad, Mr. Jayakumar said a large number of Ayyappa devotees from Andhra Pradesh visit Sabarimala every year and sought the State government’s cooperation in ensuring a smooth pilgrimage this season.

stories.title: Temple for PM Modi’s late mother to come up in Andhra Pradesh’s Kurnool district
stories.summary: A temple dedicated to Heeraben Modi, the late mother of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, is being constructed in Andhra Pradesh’s Kurnool district as a tribute to her, a charitable trust overseeing the project said on Monday, describing it as a symbol of a son’s reverence for his mother.

stories.title: Kalpathy witnesses grand meeting of temple chariots
stories.summary: Thousands of people from across the State and Tamil Nadu gathered at Kalpathy on Monday evening to witness the convergence of temple chariots, marking the finale of the annual car festival. 30 pm. The chariots represented the Viswanathaswamy Temple, Kalpathy; Manthakkara Sree Mahaganapathy Temple, New Kalpathy; Sree Lakshminarayana Perumal Temple, Old Kalpathy; and Sree Prasanna Mahaganapathy Temple, Chathapuram.

stories.title: Thane: 20-year-old man drowns in lake while performing Chhath Puja rituals
stories.summary: A 20-year-old man drowned in a lake in Maharashtra's Thane city while participating in Chhath Puja rituals on Monday morning, officials said. Thane Municipal Corporation ‘s (TMC) disaster management chief, Yasin Tadvi , said that the incident occurred at a lake located inside the Mafatlal Compound, adjacent to the Kalwa railway station, as cited by PTI.

stories.title: Tata Power installs battery storage systems in Mahalaxmi, Saki and Mankhurd
stories.summary: Tata Power has operationalised 60 MWh of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) across three strategic locations in Mumbai’s Mahalaxmi, Saki, and Mankhurd to strengthen the city's electricity distribution network and improve power reliability. Officials noted that the installations are expected to help manage peak electricity demand, optimise power procurement costs and improve the resilience of the city's power supply network, which serves more than eight lakh consumers.

stories.title: AQI ‘poor’ in parts of Kolkata, outskirts amid Chhath celebrations
stories.summary: Air quality in parts of Kolkata and its outskirts remained 'poor' on Monday (November 16, 2026) following the bursting of firecrackers during Chhath Puja celebrations in the early morning hours, a West Bengal Pollution Control Board (WBPCB) official said. Barrackpore on the northern fringes of Kolkata recorded an Air Quality Index (AQI) of 230, placing it in the 'poor' category, according to air monitoring data, the official said.

stories.title: Every Chhath, the same question returns: Why is the Yamuna still polluted?
stories.summary: Every year during Chhath Puja, images of devotees standing amid toxic foam bring the Yamuna’s pollution crisis back into focus. Despite decades of court interventions, government plans and cleanup projects, the river remains heavily polluted as it passes through Delhi. Experts say the key challenge is not just increasing river flow, but stopping untreated sewage and waste from entering the river in the first place.

stories.title: Sabarimala temple to open for annual pilgrimage; AI cameras part of crowd management
stories.summary: The sanctum sanctorum of the Sabarimala temple will open on Monday ahead of the annual Mandalam - Makaravilakku pilgrimage season, which begins on November 17. While the pilgrimage season formally begins Tuesday, which marks the first day of the Malayalam month of Vrischikam, the temple doors will open to pilgrims on Monday evening itself.

stories.title: Tamannaah Bhatia joins Chhath Puja celebrations in Mumbai, shares video after The Vvaan's festive sequence won hearts
stories.summary: Actor Tamannaah Bhatia recently joined devotees at Chhath Puja celebrations in Mumbai. The actor took to Instagram to share a video from the celebrations, in which she was seen interacting with fans and taking part in the festivities. Tamannaah recently featured in The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest, and the film's Chhath Puja sequence received much love from audiences.

stories.title: 22-year-old man drowns at Dombivali pond while celebrating Chhath Puja
stories.summary: A 22-year-old man drowned in Dawadi Talao in Dombivali on Sunday evening while celebrating Chhath Puja with his siblings. The deceased, Jugunu Kashyap, a resident of Dombivali East, jumped into the pond around 6 pm despite his siblings warning him against it. His body was yet to be recovered till the time of going to press.

stories.title: Chhath Puja Usha Arghya 2026: Check City-Wise Sunrise Timings In Mumbai, Delhi, Patna And More To Break
stories.summary: After four days of prayers, fasting and devotion, Chhath Puja reaches its conclusion with the first rays of the Sun on Monday, November 16. The final ritual, known as Usha Arghya, brings devotees together at riverbanks, ponds and other water bodies to offer prayers to the rising Sun.

stories.title: Mumbai: CM Fadnavis attends Chhath Puja at Juhu beach, says festivals strengthen national unity
stories.summary: Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis on Sunday said Indian festivals play an important role in strengthening national unity by bringing together people from different communities and backgrounds. He was speaking at a Chhath Puja celebration organised at Juhu Beach in Mumbai, where thousands of devotees gathered to offer prayers to the setting Sun and seek the blessings of Chhathi Maiya.

stories.title: Chhath Puja Sandhya Arghya Muhurat Today: Check Sunset Timings In Mumbai And Other Cities, Check Complete
stories.summary: Chhath Puja is approaching one of its most important moments as devotees prepare to gather near rivers, ponds and other water bodies to worship the setting Sun. The evening ritual, known as Sandhya Arghya, holds a special place in the four-day festival, with families coming together to offer prayers and seek blessings for their loved ones.

stories.title: From Karna to Sita: The legends from the Mahabharata and Ramayana associated with Chhath Puja
stories.summary: Every year, Chhath Puja brings devotees to water bodies to offer prayers to Surya Dev, the Sun God. The four-day festival is dedicated to Sun worship, and one of its most important rituals is offering arghya to both the setting and rising Sun. While the evening offering is made to the setting Sun, devotees return the next morning to pray to the rising Sun.

stories.title: Chhath Puja 2026: The story of Chhathi Maiyaa, the mother goddess who protects children and blesses families during Chhath Puja
stories.summary: Chhath Puja is commonly associated with the worship of Surya Dev, but the festival also honors Chhathi Maiyaa, who is worshipped as a mother goddess and protector of children. Devotees seek her blessings for the good health and long life of their children, as well as happiness and prosperity in their families.

stories.title: Gratitude as a wellness practice: What Chhath Puja teaches us about mental and emotional balance?
stories.summary: Gratitude is not just appreciation. It’s a way of acknowledging the forces and energies that sustain us. One of its most beautiful cultural expressions is Chhath Puja, a festival devoted to the Sun, the universal source of light, warmth and life. In Indian culture, the Sun is worshipped as Surya Dev, a symbol of vitality, consciousness, and strength.

stories.title: Starting a new chapter in life? What ancient spiritual teachings say about letting go and beginning again
stories.summary: Starting a new chapter in life can feel exciting, but it can also bring uncertainty. Whether you are leaving a relationship, changing careers, moving to a new city or trying to move beyond a difficult experience, beginning again often requires you to leave something familiar behind. Spiritual traditions have explored this idea for centuries.

stories.title: Chhath Puja music falls silent at railway stations after opposition objects | Mumbai news
stories.summary: Rather than face the music from opposition political parties, the Central Railway has pulled the Bhojpuri soundtracks being played at various suburban railway stations and rail terminuses on the eve of the Chhath Puja festival. The decision was taken only hours after the Shiv Sena (UBT) and Maharashtra Navnirma Sena (MNS) publicly voiced their opposition to the “imposition of North Indian culture on Maharashtra”.

stories.title: Mumbai railway stations face backlash over Bhojpuri songs played ahead of Chhath Puja | India News
stories.summary: A controversy erupted on Thursday over the playing of Bhojpuri songs at some train stations in Mumbai ahead of the Chhath Puja festival, with the move drawing criticism and raising questions over the use of Railway announcement systems for cultural events.
